headline: Eleven keeps its own counsel.
body: The last shopfront has already gone dark; only the chemist’s green cross still ticks. Somewhere a tap is left running a thin thread, then someone thinks better of it. We leave the desk lamp low and let the hour pass without asking it questions.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: cloud lid, no stars worth naming

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: one lamp, circle no wider than the page
